title: Gate-matrix/criteria mismatch
text: Gate-matrix/criteria mismatch: AC15 defines repeated-run recall and cost aggregation only when both configurations were repeated, but comparative recall and cost claims do not otherwise require equal run counts. A reachable sweep-on N>1 / sweep-off N=1 evidence set therefore has no defined aggregation or admissibility outcome. Require equal run counts or explicitly define/reject asymmetric runs consistently in AC15 and the claim-admissibility matrix.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 5628629, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
